heading: Make the creation process more intelligent!

blocks.html: After understanding the backend logic of character creation model with the engineers and aligning with the PM on the necessary steps for creating a character, I created the wireframes. I divided the creation process into several stages, and each was followed by a complete page to provide creators with a sense of achievement psychologically.
➡️ EASY FIRST: Break down the creation process into different steps to start with easier tasks.
👆🏻 CLICK AND NEXT: Increase the number of clickable options for users & Reduce manual typing input.
🥳 POSITIVE GUIDANCE: Give creators a clear outline of each step to guide them to easily create step by step.

blocks.alt: Conch Ai — Make the creation process more intelligent!
